Now, I'll go back and refine the questions, making sure they adhere to the rules. I'll double-check for answer leakage and that the questions are specific and canonical. Also, the output format is critical: This needs to be perfect JSON. I'll have to make sure every key matches the specified schema exactly. With these questions, I can build out the JSON structure per the request.
